scope: The same actual archived full UI and generated WAV were used; only Live callback delivery was capped to the observed slow cadence.
The fixed candidate overlaid the three stated VAD modules on 27 immutable base assets. The final integrated app additionally includes the separate ACK status fix.
MediaRecorder capture, WebM/Opus, browser microphone input and WebAudio playback were native; STT, chat and TTS response data were local deterministic fixtures.
Natural uncapped runs had both pass and failure outcomes; the controlled comparison isolates cadence without claiming every recording fails.
Observed timestamps reproduce admission behavior, not product/model latency or physical-headset performance.
Long-stall spike and quiet-candidate regressions, ordinary minimum speech/endpoint settings and lifecycle cleanup are covered separately by executable Node tests.
